subject: In adults with HIV, semaglutide slowed biological aging markers
script: From Agewell Brief: In adults with HIV, semaglutide slowed biological aging markers. New research in adults with HIV suggests semaglutide could influence aging markers, but experts urge caution. Semaglutide slowed biological aging markers in adults with HIV. First clinical evidence the drug may influence human aging. Larger studies needed before confirming anti-aging effects. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
